selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main idea does this passage teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah’s power handles countless things as easily as one thing, and nothing is hard for Him.

questions.question: How is Allah’s eternal power pictured at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: It is pictured as the most excellent and subtle light.

questions.question: What do all created things have in common in this passage?
questions.answer: They all obey Allah’s command.

questions.question: What does the passage say about creating many things next to each other?
questions.answer: It says this happens with the same ease as creating one thing.

questions.question: What groups of words are used to show that all categories are equal before Allah’s power?
questions.answer: The passage mentions large and small, many and few, and individual and general.

questions.question: In the example of the scale, why is the walnut important?
questions.answer: It shows that even a very small addition can bring a big change when the system is balanced.

questions.question: What point is the balance example meant to teach?
questions.answer: It teaches that under Allah’s wise law, very great things can be directed with ease and precision.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the source of all order and regularity in creation?
questions.answer: It comes from Allah’s justice and endless wisdom within His eternal power.

questions.question: Besides flies, what other living things are mentioned as receiving life in spring?
questions.answer: Plants and animals are also mentioned.

questions.question: What are the many springtime revivals called in meaning?
questions.answer: They are presented as many examples that point to resurrection.

questions.question: What is the central message of this passage?
questions.answer: The passage teaches that Allah’s eternal power works with complete ease over everything, whether one thing or many things.

questions.question: What are things compared to because of their inner nature?
questions.answer: They are compared to bright mirrors.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the response of all things to Allah’s command?
questions.answer: All things are obedient and under His authority.

questions.question: What does the passage say about making many things together?
questions.answer: It says making many things together is as easy as making one.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying the particular and the universal are the same for Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It means an individual thing and a broad group are equally easy for Him to handle.

questions.question: What does the military example add to the main idea?
questions.answer: It shows that one command can direct either one person or many people without needing a different kind of order.

questions.question: How does the passage connect wisdom with the motion of the stars?
questions.answer: It says the stars move through the wisdom of Allah’s order.

questions.question: How does the passage compare moving stars with moving atoms?
questions.answer: It says Allah moves the stars just as easily as He moves atoms.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah giving life in spring?
questions.answer: He gives life to one small creature and to whole groups of creatures equally easily.

questions.question: How does the passage connect a tree and the whole earth?
questions.answer: It says Allah gives life to a tree and also revives the earth with equal ease through His wise and just power.

questions.question: What does this passage mainly explain about Allah’s power and creation?
questions.answer: It explains that Allah creates and controls all things with perfect ease, no matter how many or how large they are.

questions.question: Why are the inner realities of things compared to mirrors?
questions.answer: Because they are presented as able to receive and display the effects of Allah’s power.

questions.question: What attitude do all created things have toward Allah’s command in this passage?
questions.answer: They are fully obedient and submit to it.

questions.question: Why does the passage say creating endless things together is natural?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s power is unlimited and the whole creation submits to it.
